coordinatorSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Thirteen attacks run, none landed. Custody is clean: 221e3dce at 0444 unmoved, dispatch and prompt agreeing, HEAD never left e68cc88, file 08 at 23cdf039 and COORD at 0c85e7bb with a clean tree, and all six file pins plus the D-147 commit pin reproducing. The entry records what it says it records. Its seven leftover classes are exactly the artifact's seven, compared as a set, and NT-4 is carried across with both halves of the artifact's careful position — that its pass is already named as DR-133 execution at G21 under D-145 and G23 under D-147, and that this entry does not name DR-131 NT-4 at those gates. That second sentence is the one my v1 finding produced, and it survives into the record intact rather than being softened. My own join verdict is represented exactly at ACCEPT 0/0 with no advisories attributed to me; the Codex half I confirmed only as a digest. Every dispatch prohibition is refused in terms, the readiness recital matches the post-D-147 register on all three figures — zero SATISFIED, 4 of 32, and condition 4 MET at 19 of 19 — and live file 08 still shows 23 gate rows, so nothing was added. Two things I checked specifically because they were defects earlier in this sequence and are not defects here. The binds-NOTHING clause in Decision 1 is correct for this branch, matching the artifact's own field, unlike the D-145 naming recording where the same phrase contradicted an assertion that naming had taken effect. And Decision 4 is titled 'Proposed later work, not performed here' with a permissive body, which is exactly the repair I proposed in CLAUDE-D146-ADV1 for D-146's mismatched heading — measured, the string 'Owed later' does not occur in this entry at all. Two items are recorded as considered and declined, including that the entry routes no advisories from the join cycle: mine carried none, and whether Codex's did is not checkable by me. After this entry, seven DR-131 NT classes remain leftover-design with no obligation and closing them is a later cycle's choice; DR-131 stays OPEN, not eligible in kind, not SATISFIED.
